game.name: MagnaCarta II (USA)(En,Fr)(Disc 1)
game.desc: MagnaCarta II is a role-playing game that invites us to follow Juto and his companions, the only beings capable of putting an end to the terrible civil war that is ravaging the kingdom of Lanzheim. The software offers six playable characters, four magicians with different powers and two hand-to-hand combatants, but only three of them can be active on the field at the same time.
